text.tspan: <LA-SC-01> Maintain EPS Evidence Chain Logical Activity
Realizes F-01. Inputs and outputs retain the F-01 signature. A failed transfer,
unavailable record, rejected artifact, or invalid chain is routed through workflow
control to an explicit assessment and retained discrepancy. No path replaces the prior
Resolve evidence baseline and source revisions
Scope designated evidence chain : 'Scope Evidence Chain'
Register external artifacts : 'Register External Engineering Artifacts'
Validate designated evidence chain : 'Validate Evidence Chain'
Issue evidence-chain assessment : 'Issue Evidence Chain Assessment'
